correctness.rationale: A crossing tile uses all four sides, so a position touching an edge adjacent to an empty face is forbidden. Exhausting cube-support symmetry types gives B1=(n-2)^2, B2=2(n-1)(n-2), B3=3(n-1)^2, B4=2(n-1)(2n-1), and B5=n^2+4n(n-1)=5n^2-4n. Independent enumeration of every proper nonempty face support for n=2,...,8 reproduced the formulas; the symbolic support count proves all n. Combining them with the published six-face theorem yields the stated necessary lower bound for the face invariant.
